scope: Diagnostic external-engine comparison, not new held-out validation or production promotion
reference: Ubuntu jammy libime 1.0.11-1build1; not current upstream 1.1.17
referenceAssets: Unmodified packaged sc.dict and zh_CN.lm, with package metadata/hash/copyright records
configuration: NBest=10; Inner; packaged beam/frame defaults; fresh PinyinContext per query; no learn/save. Package 1.0.11 predates CommonTypo/AdvancedTypo.
workload: Existing E13 dev 64 and opened test 124 whole-sentence rows only; type each ASCII letter incrementally; no external editor context
senseComparator: E13 before weights, same query/label identities, Chinese whole-sentence pool; no E13 learned weights
candidatePolicy: Retain engine candidate order; full coverage only for paired rank metrics; deduplicate text and take first 10; separately retain displayed first prefix
modelDataBoundary: Upstream training intersection with Tatoeba is unknown; no fresh-data claim
runtimeBoundary: Host C++ under WSL only, no installation/activation of system IME or Android backend; no latency comparison with JVM or Android
decision: Use evidence to choose a next engineering prototype, not automatically replace the working engine
